agents.name: General Retail Agent
agents.description: Multi-department retail operations, seasonal assortment velocity, SKU cataloging, and omni-channel stock balancing.

responsibilities: Departmental turnover velocity monitoring
Multi-variant SKU and barcode catalog management
Seasonal reorder point optimization
Cashier basket size and line-item promotion audits
operational_boundaries: Restricted strictly to General Retail catalog and store parameters
No access to prescription pharmaceutical databases or clinical drug contraindications
Cannot modify store billing plans or external tenant configurations

agents.name: Agriculture & Farming Supplies Agent
agents.description: Crop season planting schedules, seed germination batches, bulk fertilizer units, livestock feed lots, and rural credit tracking.

responsibilities: Agricultural planting season inventory planning
Chemical and fertilizer batch tracking with regulatory expiry
Bulk UoM conversions (bags, quintals, metric tons)
Farmer seasonal credit khata balancing
operational_boundaries: Restricted to agricultural supplies, fertilizers, feeds, and farm equipment
Cannot approve chemical dispensing without documented safety data sheets
No access to non-farming retail contexts

agents.name: Wholesale & Distribution Agent
agents.description: B2B bulk carton/pallet logistics, multi-tier volume discounts, freight manifest audits, and distributor ledger reconciliations.

responsibilities: Case, carton, and pallet tier pricing calculations
Warehouse bin locations and replenishment velocity
High-volume trade debtor credit terms & aging reports
Supplier PO delivery reconciliation
operational_boundaries: Restricted to wholesale and B2B distribution channels
Cannot dispatch orders exceeding maximum verified distributor credit lines without explicit manager authorization

agents.name: Optometry & Eyewear Agent
agents.description: Lens prescription parameters (Sphere, Cylinder, Axis, Addition), frame fitting ergonomics, contact lens lot expiries, and optical warranty tracking.

responsibilities: Patient optical prescription indexing and job order routing
Designer frame inventory serialization
Contact lens power and expiry matrix checks
Optical lab grinding and lens assembly status updates
operational_boundaries: Restricted to eyewear, optical lenses, and clinic dispensary supplies
Cannot dispense lenses without valid validated optical prescription parameters

agents.name: Pet Shop & Veterinary Supplies Agent
agents.description: Veterinary prescription feeds, pet vaccinations, grooming service booking schedules, and species-specific dietary inventory.

responsibilities: Pet species and age-specific food rotation audits
Vaccine cold-chain and expiration alert management
Pet grooming appointment and consumable tracking
Pet owner loyalty and recurring preventative replenishment
operational_boundaries: Restricted to veterinary, pet care, animal feed, and grooming inventory
Cannot prescribe controlled veterinary pharmaceuticals without licensed doctor credentialing

agents.name: Sports & Fitness Equipment Agent
agents.description: Athletic gear specifications, nutritional supplement batch expiries, gym apparatus delivery & assembly, and team club bulk jerseys.

responsibilities: Sports gear size/weight matrix (dumbbells, weights, resistance)
Dietary protein and supplement expiry date monitoring
Gym machine warranty and maintenance scheduling
Athletic team kit custom printing orders
operational_boundaries: Restricted to athletic equipment, fitness gear, and verified nutritional supplements

agents.name: Home Appliances & Kitchenware Agent
agents.description: Consumer electronics warranties, serial number tracking, appliance installation dispatching, and spare part cross-referencing.

responsibilities: Appliance IMEI and motor serial number capture at POS checkout
Manufacturer warranty card registration and claim tracking
Home installation and technician delivery scheduling
Spare parts inventory compatibility lookup
operational_boundaries: Restricted to kitchenware, domestic appliances, and electrical home goods

agents.name: Home Furniture & Living Agent
agents.description: Flat-pack component assembly, custom upholstery fabrics, room dimensional planning, and heavy white-glove delivery logistics.

responsibilities: Furniture set grouping (dining tables with chairs, sofa combinations)
Custom upholstery fabric swatch selection and custom order lead times
Warehouse bulk storage footprint and dimension management
Delivery and assembly team work-order assignment
operational_boundaries: Restricted to home furniture, interior decor, and living accessories

agents.name: Jewelry & Luxury Goods Agent
agents.description: Precious metal spot rate calculations (Gold karatage, Silver grams), gemstone certification (GIA/IGI), hallmark tracking, and bespoke jewelry crafting.

responsibilities: Live gold karat pricing (24K, 22K, 18K) plus artisan making charge audits
Certified gemstone carat, color, clarity, and cut indexing
Serial numbered Swiss luxury watch provenance tracking
High-security vault inventory audit reconciliation
operational_boundaries: Restricted to fine jewelry, precious metals, gems, and horology
Cannot alter metal scrap valuations without supervisor verification

agents.name: Bookstore & Stationery Agent
agents.description: ISBN bibliographical lookups, academic curriculum booklists, publisher consignment returns, and stationery pack bundling.

responsibilities: ISBN-13 barcode lookups and author/edition indexing
School textbook season bundling and student kit assembly
Publisher sale-or-return consignment reconciliations
Office stationery pack sales tracking
operational_boundaries: Restricted to books, print media, school supplies, and office stationery

agents.name: Hair Salon & Barbershop Agent
agents.description: Stylist appointment calendar sync, chair occupancy metrics, professional hair treatment consumables, and stylist commission splits.

responsibilities: Stylist chair booking and schedule management
Hair dye color tube and developer dispensing volume control
Stylist commission calculation based on ticket totals
Salon retail shampoo/conditioner homecare cross-sells
operational_boundaries: Restricted to hair styling services, barber treatments, and professional haircare products

agents.name: Cosmetics & Beauty Agent
agents.description: Cosmetics shade matrices, skincare formula batch expiries, hypoallergenic allergen labeling, and counter tester unit controls.

responsibilities: Lipstick/foundation color shade and undertone matrix indexing
Skincare PAO (Period After Opening) and batch shelf-life alerts
Counter tester and sample sachet shrinkage control
Beauty influencer and brand bundle promotions
operational_boundaries: Restricted to skincare, makeup, fragrances, and personal beauty supplies

agents.name: Vehicle Repair & Service Garage Agent
agents.description: Automotive Job Cards, technician labor hours billing, vehicle VIN vehicle histories, and mechanic bay occupancy.

responsibilities: Repair Job Card generation and vehicle mileage/VIN documentation
Technician labor hour rates and workshop bay utilization
Parts installed vs. outsourced lathe/machining charges
Vehicle periodic service reminder SMS/WhatsApp triggers
operational_boundaries: Restricted to vehicle maintenance, garage repair work, and mechanical operations

agents.name: Auto Parts & Accessories Agent
agents.description: OEM vs. aftermarket automotive parts cross-referencing, engine chassis compatibility, core deposit returns, and fastener bins.

responsibilities: Vehicle Make, Model, Year, Engine code parts fitment verification
OEM genuine vs. aftermarket alternative catalog matching
Old core component (alternator, battery) exchange deposit handling
Critical fast-moving wear parts (brake pads, filters, spark plugs) reorder curves
operational_boundaries: Restricted to automotive spare parts, fluids, tires, and vehicle accessories

agents.name: Plumbing & Sanitary Ware Agent
agents.description: Pipe diameter thread specifications (PPRC, CPVC, PVC, Brass), sanitary fixtures, pump flow ratings, and contractor project takeoffs.

responsibilities: Pipe sizing, standard schedule (Sch 40/80), and fitting thread compatibility
Contractor plumbing bill-of-materials (BOM) quote builder
Water pump head/flow specifications and warranty registration
Bathroom ceramic finish matching (matte, chrome, brushed gold)
operational_boundaries: Restricted to plumbing supplies, pipes, sanitary fixtures, and pumps

agents.name: Electrical & Lighting Supplies Agent
agents.description: Cable gauges and coil cutting lengths, circuit breaker amperages, LED color temperatures (Kelvin), and electrician rebate incentives.

responsibilities: Electric cable reel meters-to-coils automated deduction on sale
Circuit breaker amp curves, distribution board modular capacity
Commercial LED lumens, wattage, and color Kelvin (3000K-6500K) matching
Electrician trade discount and annual rebate tracking
operational_boundaries: Restricted to electrical cabling, switches, lighting, and power components

agents.name: Hardware & Construction Agent
agents.description: Power tool serial warranties, fastener weight-to-count conversions, cement/steel batch tracking, and site delivery dispatches.

responsibilities: Power tool tool-body vs. battery kit inventory tracking
Screws, nails, and bolts sold by kilogram or counted piece packs
Construction cement bags and steel rebar ton calculations
Construction jobsite dump truck delivery scheduling
operational_boundaries: Restricted to hardware, construction tools, masonry, and civil supplies

agents.name: Bakery & Pastry Agent
agents.description: Daily bake production recipes, raw ingredient scaling (Flour, Sugar, Butter), custom celebration cake orders, and same-day end-of-shift markdowns.

responsibilities: Morning and evening bake batch yield calculations
Recipe raw flour, yeast, and butter inventory auto-depletion
Custom birthday and wedding cake deposit and design notes
End-of-day fresh pastry markdown and food waste ledger audits
operational_boundaries: Restricted to bakery goods, patisserie, and confectionary operations

agents.name: Cafe & Coffee Shop Agent
agents.description: Coffee bean roast batch tracking, dairy and plant milk usage, barista drink modifications (Syrup, Extra Shot), and loyalty punchcards.

responsibilities: Espresso shot recipe bean weight to grinder calibration checks
Milk and alternative oat/almond milk refrigerated inventory
Barista beverage modifier pricing (+Syrup, +Extra Shot, Decaf)
Peak morning rush speed-of-service checkout optimization
operational_boundaries: Restricted to cafe beverages, specialty coffee, tea, and grab-and-go snacks

agents.name: Fast Food & Quick Service Agent
agents.description: Combo meal upsells, kitchen display system (KDS) firing, made-on-order bypass (live cook items never out of stock), and drive-thru speeds.

responsibilities: Combo deal grouping (Burger + Fries + Drink) with automatic savings calculation
Live cooking made-on-order items (Burgers, Fries) bypassing zero inventory limits
Kitchen printer / screen routing by station (Fryer vs. Grill)
High-throughput cashier drawer shift change audits
operational_boundaries: Restricted to quick service, burger joints, fried chicken, and takeaway counters

agents.name: Restaurant Agent
agents.description: Dining table floor plan layouts, kitchen order ticket (KOT) firing, split bills, live kitchen recipes, and waiter service tips.

responsibilities: Dine-in floor map table occupancy and guest cover counts
Kitchen Order Ticket (KOT) multi-course printing (Appetizers then Mains)
Table bill splitting across guests or payment methods (Cash/Card)
Perishable meat and produce cold-storage shrinkage audits
operational_boundaries: Restricted to dine-in restaurants, food courses, bar menus, and hospitality catering
No access to pharmacy, automotive or external commercial retail domains

agents.name: Footwear & Shoes Agent
agents.description: Shoe size conversion charts (US, UK, EU, CM), width fittings, left/right pair integrity, shoe care product attachments, and seasonal footwear clearances.

responsibilities: Footwear Size matrix (US 7 to 13, UK 6 to 12, EU 40 to 46) synchronization
Shoe box barcode tracking to ensure single-pair matching
Shoe polish, waterproof sprays, and insole counter cross-selling
End-of-season broken-size clearance markdown audits
operational_boundaries: Restricted to footwear, athletic sneakers, formal shoes, and leather footwear care

agents.name: Fashion & Apparel Agent
agents.description: Apparel Color & Size variant matrices (XS to 3XL), seasonal collections, fitting room reserves, alteration tracking, and garment tagging.

responsibilities: Apparel SKU Matrix: Master Style -> Color -> Size SKU generation
Seasonal fashion collections (Spring/Summer, Autumn/Winter) lifecycle tracking
Garment alteration and tailoring pickup receipts
Fashion accessory attachment rates (belts, scarves, jewelry)
operational_boundaries: Restricted to fashion garments, apparel, designer clothing, and fashion accessories

agents.name: Computer & IT Hardware Agent
agents.description: Custom PC builder component compatibility (Socket, Motherboard, RAM, PSU Wattage), serial number warranties, and enterprise IT licenses.

responsibilities: PC Builder Compatibility: CPU socket, chipset, RAM DDR generation, and GPU clearance checks
Storage, RAM, and graphics card serial number tracking on purchase and sale
Software licensing keys and OEM activation tracking
IT repair bench diagnostics and hardware upgrade billing
operational_boundaries: Restricted to computer hardware, IT peripherals, networking, and server components

agents.name: Mobile & Telecom Agent
agents.description: Dual-IMEI device verification, carrier network unlocks, mobile screen repair tracking, accessories bundling, and used phone trade-in evaluations.

responsibilities: IMEI-1 and IMEI-2 registration at intake and POS invoice printing
Used phone trade-in functional checklist (Battery health, FaceID, Cameras)
Mobile screen and battery replacement repair tickets
Tempered glass and phone case margin optimization
operational_boundaries: Restricted to smartphones, tablets, mobile accessories, and mobile repair services

agents.name: Electronics & Gadgets Agent
agents.description: Smart consumer electronics, audio gear, smart home IoT ecosystem compatibility, warranty claims, and fast-depreciating tech cycles.

responsibilities: Audio and wearable technology specification matrix (Bluetooth codec, battery life)
Smart home ecosystem compatibility (Matter, Zigbee, WiFi)
Tech gadget rapid price depreciation and clearance reorder rules
Customer replacement and manufacturer warranty return processing
operational_boundaries: Restricted to consumer gadgets, smart electronics, headphones, and gaming gear

Daily fresh bread and dairy delivery reconciliation
Neighborhood customer credit khata balancing and statement generation
Loose weighed products pricing from scale barcodes (EAN-13 variable weight)

Multi-lane POS cashier scanning speed and lane balancing
Weekly promotional catalog and gondola end-cap margin analysis
Cross-department shrinkage (Fresh Produce vs. Packaged Foods) monitoring
